title: 第13章 元阳债第14章 关键人物
content_zh:
落云山庄的少庄主，在天石城绝对是名人。
出手阔绰，一掷千金，风流倜傥，气宇非凡，最主要的是生得一副好皮囊，从头到脚完美无瑕，帅到骨子里的那种。
赌坊喜欢少庄主，酒楼喜欢少庄主，青楼更是喜欢少庄主。
就连街边卖糖葫芦的老妪见到少庄主都要笑脸相迎，发自内心的喜欢，因为这位阔少想吃糖葫芦的话，扔出来的都是足两的纹银，身上根本没铜钱。
简单一句话总结：庄稼最爱带粪的土，人见人爱是少庄主。
“少庄主好狠心呢，三天没来玉香楼了，人家特意为少庄主学了一支舞，每天练到深夜，脚都酸了呢。”
一名浓妆艳抹的紫裙女子几乎是贴在云极身上，娇声娇气的说道。
“这么严重啊，那得好好治一治了，待会儿本公子用冰敷的办法帮你按按脚踝，肯定管用。”云极故作担忧的说道。
“冰敷才不灵呢，女儿家不喜欢凉的东西。”紫裙女子嘟起红唇。
“放心，你肯定喜欢，因为本公子用的是冰镇灵石。”云极笑道。
“少庄主你好坏呀。”紫裙女子柔弱无力的捶了下云极，娇嗔道：“我好喜欢！”
云极哈哈一笑。
果然还是熟悉的调调，修行界看来没有想象中那么无聊嘛。
围在身边的都是年轻女子，风情各异，模样没有一个丑的，至少都在中上之资。
毕竟这里是玉香楼，赚的是灵石，可不是银子。
在玉香楼里拿出银子，这些拥有修为的风尘女子连正眼都不带看的。
相比于云极的大受欢迎，熊傲那边冷冷清清，没一个女人过去献殷勤。
熊傲身为筑基境妖物，他自然也能找人族女子玩乐，不过在玉香楼不行。
玉香楼的东家定下一条铁律。
妖族客人，酒菜可以吃，并且享受专属折扣，但是想要玉香楼的美人侍寝，恕不接待。

云极坐下后，才想起来这条规矩，不由得对玉香楼东家泛起一丝好奇。
这个人不简单。
能在天石城这种鱼龙混杂之地开设青楼，本就彰显出此人的手腕，而这条规矩又定得十分巧妙。
青楼不接待妖族，是人家不想看到人族女子被妖族玩弄，代表着心底的一份坚持。
在酒楼一方给出妖族专属折扣，吃饭的价格比人族还便宜，这就是对妖族示好了。
一手平衡术，玩得有点水平。
拿过菜单，云极点了一桌菜，大部分是灵材制作的灵菜，又要了一坛灵酒。
这一顿饭，价值在一百灵石。
看得周围的美人眼热不已，恨不得投怀送抱。
但是规矩就是规矩，当云极与熊傲落座，无论对自己容貌多有自信的女子都不敢过来打扰，除非云极邀请。
这顿饭是专门请熊傲的，云极自然不会找不痛快请个外人来陪着吃。
这里是青楼，逢场作戏没问题，谈感情可就见外了。
“少庄主破费了嘿嘿，我可不客气喽！”
熊傲对玉香楼的美人确实眼馋，但是眼前价值上百灵石的美味佳肴更对他的胃口，张开大嘴，狂吃海塞。
云极喝着灵酒，时而夹口菜，吃得温文尔雅，比起狂吞的熊傲简直是两个极端。
豪门阔少的人设而已，对云极根本不算问题，因为他前世本身就代表着豪门二字，还是白手起家的豪门，这种风度无需刻意表演，自然而然即可，甚至比原主有过之而无不及。
远处的一众美人看得目不转睛，互相间窃窃私语。
一个新来不久的年轻女孩小声道：
“原来那就是少庄主啊，果然名不虚传，连吃饭都那么帅气，不给钱我也愿意。”
“小妮子你是痴心妄想呢。”旁边的紫裙女子嗤笑道：“别说不给钱，少庄主如果想要女人，玉香楼的姑娘们有一大半倒贴灵石的你信不信。”

“为什么要倒贴灵石呢？”年轻女孩好奇的问道。
“少庄主徘徊在炼气后期巅峰境界十余年，至今元阳未散，馋他身子的大有人在，我愿意倒贴两百灵石侍寝。”紫裙女子道。
content_en:
The young owner of Luoyun Villa is definitely a celebrity in Tianshi City.
He is generous, spends a lot of money, is suave and charming, and the most important thing is to be born with a good skin, perfect from head to toe, and handsome to the core.
Gambling houses like young village owners, restaurants like young village owners, and brothels even like young village owners.
Even the old woman selling candied haws on the street would greet the young owner with a smile and like her from the bottom of her heart, because if the wealthy young man wanted to eat candied haws, all he would throw out were two full taels of silver and he had no copper coins at all.
To sum it up in a simple sentence: Crops love soil with dung most, and everyone loves the young farm owner.
"The young master is so cruel. I haven't been to Yuxiang Tower for three days. I specially learned a dance for the young master. I practiced until late at night every day, and my feet are sore."
A woman in a purple skirt with heavy makeup almost clung to Yunji's body and said in a coquettish voice.
"It's so serious. It needs to be treated properly. I'll apply ice compress to your ankle later. It will definitely work." Yunji said pretending to be worried.
"Ice compresses won't work. My daughter doesn't like cold things." The woman in the purple skirt pursed her red lips.
"Don't worry, you must like it, because I use iced spiritual stones." Yun Ji said with a smile.
"Young Master, you are so bad." The woman in purple skirt weakly hit Yunji and said coquettishly: "I like it so much!"
Yunji laughed.
Sure enough, it's still a familiar tune. It seems that the world of spiritual practice is not as boring as imagined.
The people around him were all young women with different styles. None of them were ugly, and at least they were all of average or above-average wealth.
After all, this is Yuxiang Tower, and what you earn is spiritual stones, not money.
When they took out the money in Yuxiang Tower, these prostitutes with their cultivation base didn't even look at it.
Compared to Yunji's great popularity, Xiong Ao's place was deserted, and not a single woman came to show his attentiveness.
Xiong Ao is a Foundation Establishment Realm monster, so he can naturally have fun with human women, but not in Yuxiang Tower.
The owner of Yuxianglou has set an iron rule.
Monster guests can eat wine and food, and enjoy exclusive discounts, but if they want the beauties of Yuxiang Tower to sleep with them, they will not be accommodated.
After Yunji sat down, he remembered this rule and couldn't help but become curious about the owner of Yuxianglou.
This person is not simple.
Being able to open a brothel in a place like Tianshi City, where fish and dragons are mixed, shows this person's skill, and this rule is very clever.
The brothel does not accept monsters because they don't want to see human women being played by monsters, which represents the persistence in their hearts.
In the restaurant, the demon clan is given an exclusive discount, and the price of the meal is cheaper than that of the human race. This is a sign of goodwill to the demon clan.
He has a good balance skill and plays well.
Taking the menu, Yunji ordered a table of dishes, most of which were spiritual dishes made from spiritual materials, and also ordered a jar of spiritual wine.
This meal is worth one hundred spiritual stones.
The beauties around him were so hot-eyed that they wanted to throw themselves into their arms.
But rules are rules. When Yunji and Xiong Ao sit down, no woman, no matter how confident she is in her appearance, dares to disturb them unless Yunji invites them.
This meal was specially invited to Xiong Ao, so Yunji would naturally not hesitate to invite an outsider to accompany him.
This is a brothel, so it's okay to have fun, but it's not okay to talk about relationships.
"Young owner spent a lot of money, hey, I'm not polite!"
Xiong Ao was indeed greedy for the beauties of Yuxianglou, but the delicacies worth hundreds of spirit stones in front of him appealed to his appetite even more. He opened his mouth wide and ate Haisai like crazy.
Yunji drank the spiritual wine, occasionally picked up some vegetables, and ate in a gentle and elegant manner. Compared to Xiong Ao, who was devouring food, he was at two extremes.
It's just the character of a rich young man from a wealthy family, which is not a problem for Yunji at all, because in his previous life, he represented the word wealthy, and he was a self-made wealthy man. This kind of demeanor does not need to be deliberately performed, it just comes naturally, and is even better than the original owner.
The beauties in the distance looked at each other intently.Whisper.
A new young girl whispered:
"So that's the young owner of the village. He really deserves his reputation. He's so handsome even when he's eating. I'm willing to pay him even if he doesn't pay."
"Xiao Nizi, you are just wishful thinking." The woman in the purple skirt next to her sneered: "Don't say no money, if the young owner wants a woman, believe it or not, most of the girls in Yuxiang Tower will pay for the spirit stone."
"Why stick the spiritual stone upside down?" the young girl asked curiously.
"The young village master has been wandering around the peak state of the late stage of Qi refining for more than ten years. The Yuan Yang has not dissipated yet. There are many people who are greedy for his body. I am willing to pay two hundred spirit stones to sleep with him." said the woman in purple skirt.
